articles.title: ChaCha20 on an OpenGL compute shader
articles.summary: Mapping keystream blocks to compute invocations and an SSBO, plus three problems found on re-reading: dispatch size, unsigned uniforms set with a signed call, and no integrity.
articles.basis: Based on reading the source. Nothing was re-run.

articles.title: How the censface-cpp video pipeline works
articles.summary: Packets vs frames, YUV↔BGR conversion, display rotation, keeping source timestamps, and copying audio without decoding, with the FFmpeg C API.
articles.basis: Based on the source and the project's pipeline notes. The numbers in the last section are hand-run checks recorded in the README.

articles.title: Fragment-shader vs compute-shader ray marching
articles.summary: The same SDF ray marcher in two OpenGL execution models, the dispatch and barrier details that differ, and the int-typed uniform setter that made the compute version stutter.
articles.basis: Based on reading the source. The stutter cause is a diagnosis that has not been re-run yet.

articles.title: TD3 on TrackMania: what the logs show
articles.summary: Behaviour-cloning warm start, the post-warm-up collapse, TD3+BC regularisation, a plateau reported as a plateau, and a policy stuck against one wall.
articles.basis: Based on the experiment manifests and metrics committed in the repository (recorded results, not re-run).

external.title: Threat report: ClickFix malware campaign via typosquatted NPTEL domains
external.summary: Typosquatted entry points, redirect chain, clipboard-hijack landing page, three decoded PowerShell payload samples, C2 infrastructure, IOCs and an ATT&CK mapping. Payloads were analysed in a VM, not executed.
